opening_question_spark: Why does sorting apples get harder after less than five hours of sleep?
book_transition: The reason starts inside your tired brain.
cta: Like and subscribe to grow more questions.
body: Attention drifts, so obvious details slip past.
Reaction time slows, making mistakes more likely.
New memories become harder to store clearly.
Emotional control gets harder, so feelings can hit harder.
Hunger signals shift toward more calorie-dense foods.
Your immune system gets less recovery time.
Blood pressure and blood sugar control can worsen.
Chronic short sleep is linked with heart disease and diabetes.
Caffeine can mask sleepiness, but it cannot replace sleep.
Most adults need at least seven hours a night.
optional_closing: Five hours may save time tonight, then cost you tomorrow.
